name: ru.yoomoney.sdk.auth.socialAccounts.esia.EsiaActivity
description: In the YooMoney Authorization SDK, this Activity handles sign-in through Gosuslugi (ESIA) and receives the redirect back from that service. The YooKassa Android payment SDK also includes this authorization screen.
disableEffect: Users cannot finish signing in or linking an account through Gosuslugi from this SDK.
